headline: Every bag of frozen vegetables checked, not a sample.
formProduct: Frozen vegetables in retail and food service bags
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and video meeting with your plant team
heroLede: With many vegetable mixes and bag sizes on the same lines, every bag needs the right label and best-before code. Here's what a camera check could look like after your baggers. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every bag is sealed straight across, with no product caught in the seal. A weak seal lets in frost and air, and the bag comes back as a complaint.
labelLede: A bag of mixed vegetables and a bag of peas and corn can look much the same at line speed. The camera checks every bag carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every pack. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Film offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before bags reach a carton.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the bagger.
